text:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — prepping an enablement-focused EBR for Emerald. Need slides, concrete asks for execs, and a renewal risk map. Can folks confirm availability for a 30m run-through tomorrow 10:00am PT?

Miguel (Account Exec): I can do 10:00am. Quick ask — can Product include a one-slide impact summary on the recent latency reg change and any mitigation plan? Execs will ask.

Priya (SuccessOps): +1 to Miguel. For slides I suggest: 1) Health snapshot (metrics + onboarding), 2) Top 3 risks with owners, 3) Ask list (contract/discount/exec time), 4) Enablement plan and timeline.

Tom (Product): I won’t be on the call (back-to-back), but I’ll add the latency impact slide into the deck by EOD today and tag Miguel.

Aisha (CSM): Great, tx. Quick health snapshot numbers for the slide deck: NPS 42 (last 30d), active seats 6/8, daily usage up 12% WoW, critical connector work blocking 2 integrations.

Miguel (Account Exec): Onboarding notes: 4 training sessions completed, 2 sessions scheduled next week, 2 custom connectors in dev (ETA 2w). Renewal signal: renewal in 6w, customer expressed price sensitivity during last call.

Priya (SuccessOps): Putting together the renewal risk map — current flags: pricing sensitivity, two outstanding integrations, no recent exec-level touch. Owners (proposed): Pricing negotiation = Miguel, Integrations = Eng PM (Tom to confirm), Exec engagement = Aisha.

Aisha (CSM): Draft exec bullets for the first slide (copy this into deck):

```
- Business: 12% weekly usage lift; core workflows adopted by 3 pilot teams.
- Risk: Two blocked connectors impacting go-live date; customer indicated budget pressure.
- Ask: Exec alignment call requested to unblock procurement + proposed 6mo pricing bridge.
```

Tom (Product): Confirming integrations owner will be Jenna (Eng PM). I’ll add a short note on scope and ETA in the slide notes.

Miguel (Account Exec): I can own the pricing bridge proposal. Will draft a simple 3-option pricing slide (status quo / 6mo bridge / enterprise commit) and share by 6pm.

Priya (SuccessOps): Action items I’ll capture:
- Add health metrics slide (Priya) — due: today 5pm PT
- Add latency/regression slide (Tom) — due: today EOD
- Pricing options (Miguel) — due: today 6pm PT
- Exec ask one-pager (Aisha) — due: tomorrow 9am PT
- Schedule run-through (calendar-bot) — done below

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — Emerald EBR run-through, Tomorrow 10:00am PT, 30m. Invite sent to: Aisha, Miguel, Priya, Tom (recording enabled).

Aisha (CSM): Perfect. Priya — can you drop the slide export to the deck URL and leave a one-line note for execs about the budget ask? Miguel — once you post pricing options I’ll add numbers to the ask slide. Thanks team :pray:

Miguel (Account Exec): Will do.

Priya (SuccessOps): Deck link: https://redwood.slides/emerald-ebr (slides v1 uploaded). Left comments on slide 3 for the risk map.

Aisha (CSM): Closing loop — see comments in deck, run-through tomorrow 10:00am PT. If anything slips, flag in this thread. :thumbsup:
